description: Keeps the Dockerfile's base images and the workflow's Actions current. Every push to main publishes and deploys (AGENTS.md, Release), so base-image fixes reach the site without anyone pushing content.

packageRules.description: Base-image digest and patch updates merge automatically overnight once the image builds, ahead of home-server's 4am patch window. The window is wider than Mend's 4-hourly runs, so at least one run lands in it
Base-image minor and major updates (such as a new Node major, which should move together with mise.toml) wait for review
Actions: weekly, grouped; patch and digest updates merge automatically once the image builds
